ourStory.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Fellowship Event Hall is the rental venue at St. Mary Romanian Orthodox Church in Dacula, Georgia, serving Gwinnett County and the greater Atlanta metro area. The hall is a brand-new facility built by the parish that serves the American-Romanian community in the area.

The property is an expression of our identity, a fingerprint of our presence in the area and our contribution to Gwinnett's multi-cultural society. It is also an expression of our community at its best, through the sacrifice and dedication of a small but very active group of members.
ourStory.imageAlt: Interior of Fellowship Event Hall in Dacula, GA with tables set for a wedding reception

aboutYou.title: It's All About You
paragraphs: Our renting facility stands out in the area with a new and large parking space, beautiful green space around, privacy for your events, flexible hours, brand new building with modern design and multiple options for decorations.
It is an expression of our hospitality and a place you will feel welcomed.

items.question: Where is Saint Mary Romanian Orthodox Church located?
items.answer: 2875 Winder Hwy, Dacula, GA 30019 — serving Gwinnett County and the North Atlanta area.

items.question: How can I contact the parish office?
items.answer: Email saintmaryro@gmail.com or call 404-518-1042 for general inquiries and sacramental scheduling.

items.question: When are services held?
items.answer: The parish celebrates Sunday Divine Liturgy and observances for major feast days; see the parish calendar for exact times and seasonal schedules.

items.question: Does the parish offer community meals and events?
items.answer: Yes — the parish organizes community meals, cultural festivals, and outreach programs throughout the year.

items.question: How do I request a sacrament or pastoral visit?
items.answer: Contact the parish office or speak with clergy after services to arrange baptisms, weddings, confessions, and pastoral visits.
